notes.title: BAT HERO - Official Release Date
notes.content:
Greetings everyone,

This is with great pleasure for me to make this announcement, the official release date for Bat Hero is finally set for [b]March 8, 2023 at 4 PM CET or  7 AM PST.[/b]

[i]Legendary Edition :[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43209267/35c2316e1f3afa5437e50f39af7de0ae6233db50.jpg[/img]

As part of the release, any purchase of the game during the first 3 months of release will grant you the Legendary edition with [b]unique and exclusive cosmetics[/b] but also will grant you [b]access to every future expansions of the game[/b], so be sure to grab the game before the offer is over.

Since the release date is set for March 8, every purchase before June 8, 2023 will grant you access to the legendary edition and all its content.

The wait is finally over.

[b]Time to swing ![/b]

[i]Best Regards,
Bahamun[/i]
